note: Follow-up to the earlier synthetic memory test (full-test-results.json), which found the automatic Memory subsystem empty after short 'please remember this fact' test messages. The tester separately shared their actual CV with Thaura in a genuine chat conversation (outside this session's automation), and the Memory panel subsequently populated with real content - confirming the automatic memory feature does work, just not on short synthetic commands.

body.content:
## Overview

You are reviewing the CV of Ferdous Hasan, a junior SQA engineer with about 1.7 years of experience in QA and AI application development.

observation: The two sections ('Overview' and 'Work') contain near-duplicate sentences, and both are phrased in second person imperative ('You are reviewing...') rather than as a third-person fact summary - suggesting the memory content is written as a standing instruction/context block to be injected back into the assistant's own context in future turns, not as a neutral note-to-self about the user.
